description: The bar chart illustrates the performance gain of three models, GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Qwen2-72B-VL, under two supervision conditions, with the categories listed on the horizontal axis in the order of GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Qwen2-72B-VL. The vertical axis is labeled "Performance Gain (+%)" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick labels at intervals of 5. Each category has two bars, with the striped bar representing "Strong Supervision" and the solid bar representing an unspecified condition, colored in different shades of blue. The bars for GPT-4o have values of approximately 24 and 5, for Claude-3.5-Sonnet approximately 9 and 3, and for Qwen2-72B-VL approximately 15 and 5. The chart does not indicate any specific sorting order beyond the listed category order, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond the color and pattern differentiation provided by the legend.
